senses.gloss: जम्बाल- + अङ्क जम्बाल- + अङ्क, adj. full of swamps.

जम् जम्, i. 1, Par. To eat.
 --Frequent. To chew, anomal. जाजम्, MBh. 13, 4495.
जमदग्नि जमदग्नि, m. The name of a Ṛṣi, MBh. 1, 2611.

जम्बाल जम्बाल, m. Mud, Rājat. 5, 94.
 --Comp.

जम्बु जम्बु, and जम्बू जम्बू, f.
 1. [] A fruit tree, the rose apple, Eugenia jambu, MBh. 1, 7587; Pañc. 205, 5.
 2. The name of a division of the world, comprising India (cf. द्वीप), Bhāg. P. 5, 1, 32.
 3. The name of a fabulous river, Bhāg. P. 5, 20, 2.
 --Comp.
जम्बुक जम्बुक, m. A jackal, Pañc. 35, 2. f. का, A female jackal, Pañc. iv. d. 64.
जाम्बुक जाम्बुक, i. e. जम्बुक + अ, adj. Proceeding from a jackal, MBh. 12, 5779.
जम्बूल जम्बूल, m. A fragrant plant, Pandanus odoratissimus, Hariv. 5371.
जम्भ् जम्भ्, see जभ् and यभ्.

जम्भ जम्भ, i. e. जभ् + अ,
 I. m., f. भा, and n.
 1. The jaws, the teeth, a tooth (ved.).
 2. Cracking, explaining, MBh. 5, 2474.
 II. m. A proper name.
 --Cf. γαμϕηλαί, γόμϕιος; A.S. geaflas.

जम्भक जम्भ् + अक,
 I. adj.
 1. Bruising, Rām. 1, 30, 9.
 2. Cracking, explaining, MBh. 5, 2470.
 II. m.
 1. The name of certain demons, Rām. 1, 31, 4 Gorr.
 2. The name of a spell, Rām. 1, 31, 9.
जम्भन जम्भ् + अन, adj., f. नी, Bruising, MBh. 6, 807.
जामदग्नेय जामदग्नेय, i. e. जमदग्नि + एय, patron. A descendant of Jamadagni, Rām. 1, 74, 17.

जामदग्न्य जामदग्न्य, i. e. जमदग्नि + य,
 I. adj. Referring to Jamadagni, MBh. 1, 332.
 II. patron. A descendant of Jamadagni, Rām. 1, 74, 23.
जामा जामा (from *जम् = γαμ in γαμέω, an older form of यम्, by the aff. अ; cf. the next), f. A daughter-in-law, MBh. 13, 2474.

जामातृ जामातृ (from *जम्, cf. the [] last and यामातृ, by the aff. तृ), m. A son-in-law, Rām. 1, 8, 26.
 --Cf. γαμβρός for γαμρός; Lat. gener for gem + ros.
जामातृक जामातृ + क, adj. Belonging to a son-in-law, Pañc. 46, 19.
जामातृत्व जामातृ + त्व, n. Condition of being a son-in-law, Pañc. 48, 23.

जामि जामि (from *जम्, cf. जामा, but in the signification which appears in Lat. gem-ini and Sskt. यम, Twin, a pair),
 I. adj. and sbst. Brother and sister; related (ved.).
 II. also जामी जामी, f.
 1. A female relation, Man. 3, 57.
 2. A sister, Yājñ. 1, 157.
जामित्र जामित्र, The seventh house in Astrology, Kumāras. 7, 1.

जाम्बव जाम्बव, i. e.
 I. जम्बु + अ,
 1. adj. Coming from the Jambu-tree, Suśr. 1, 190, 5.
 2. n. The fruit of the Jambu-tree, 1, 73, 17.
 II. = जाम्बवन्त्, A proper name, Rām. 5, 1, 57.
जाम्बवन्त् जाम्बवन्त्, m. A proper name, Rām. 4, 25, 33. f. वती, A proper name, MBh. 3, 670.

जाम्बुनद and जाम्बूनद जाम्बू̆नद, i. e. जम्बू̆-नदी + अ,
 I. adj. Coming from the river Jambu, epithet of a peculiar kind of gold, MBh. 6, 279.
 II. n. Gold, Rām. 3, 49, 9.
 III. adj., f. दी, Golden, Rām. 5, 7, 19.
 IV. m.
 1. A proper name, MBh. 1, 3745.
 2. The name of a mountain, MBh. 3, 10835.
 V. f. दी, The name of a river, MBh. 6, 338.
 VI. n.
 1. A golden ornament, Śiś. 4, 66.
 2. The name of a sea, MBh. 5, 3843.
जाम्बुनदमय and जाम्बूनदमय [] जाम्बू̆नद + मय, adj., f. यी, Golden, Pañc. 175, 8.

जम्बू- + द्वीप जम्बू- + द्वीप, m. the name of one of the seven divisions of the world, and implying the central division, or the known world; according to the Bauddhas, it is confined to India, MBh. 6, 207; Lalit. 27.

जम्बु- + पर्वत जम्बु- + पर्वत, m. = जम्बु
 2. वर्ष-, m. A mountainous range supposed to separate the Varṣas, or divisions of the globe, from each other.
